kpis.description_fr: Primes brutes Non-Life (auto, habitation, santé). Croissance +7 % en 2024 portée par MV TPL (+6,8 %) et Land Vehicle Hulls (+15,2 %). Cœur de business Unipol Italie.
kpis.description_en: Non-Life gross written premiums (motor, home, health). +7% growth in 2024 driven by MV TPL (+6.8%) and Land Vehicle Hulls (+15.2%). Unipol Italy core business.

kpis.description_fr: Combined Ratio (loss + expense). <100 % = sous-écriture profitable. Amélioration 2024 grâce hausse tarifs MV TPL. Cible long terme <95 %.
kpis.description_en: Combined Ratio (loss + expense). <100% = profitable underwriting. 2024 improvement thanks to MV TPL rate hikes. Long-term target <95%.

kpis.description_fr: Primes brutes Vie + Pension Funds. Reprise 2024 post-décrochage 2022-2023 (concurrence Treasuries IT 4 %+). Mix unit-linked en hausse.
kpis.description_en: Gross Life + Pension Funds premiums. 2024 recovery after 2022-2023 drop (vs Italian Treasuries 4%+). Unit-linked mix rising.

kpis.description_fr: Ratio Solvency II. KPI réglementaire EU pour assureurs. >200 % = fort buffer capital, capacité distribution dividende / rachats actions / M&A.
kpis.description_en: Solvency II ratio. EU regulatory KPI for insurers. >200% = strong capital buffer, dividend / buyback / M&A capacity.

kpis_story.description_fr: Prise participation Commerzbank 21% (sep 2024) puis option à 28-29%. M&A bancaire transfrontalière européenne en débat. Hostilité gouvernement DE.
kpis_story.description_en: Commerzbank 21% stake taken (Sep 2024) then 28-29% option. Cross-border European bank M&A in debate. German government hostility.

_notes: Unipol : KPIs assureur composite (Non-Life GWP + Combined Ratio underwriting / Life GWP / Solvency II capital). Italie marché clé MV TPL.
